chunks: Verily We shall inherit the earth and whosoever is on it, and to Us they will return.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God inheriting the earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Alam al-Dharr* and the ultimate inheritance of the earth by the Ahl al-Bayt, signifying their spiritual and temporal authority over creation. It underscores the transient nature of worldly dominion compared to the eternal sovereignty of God, reinforcing the eschatological return (*al-Ma'ad*) central to Shia theology.
